prompt:
今回のテーマについて、Webで調査し、Verified Fact Ledgerの下書きを作成してください。

【今回のテーマ】
Current news/lifestyle topic: whether small ("mini" or "micro") handbags are genuinely gaining renewed attention in fashion right now, as a light, consumer/lifestyle-oriented story (not hard news such as AI, space security, or policy). Research this without assuming the conclusion that 'tiny bags are back' — actively check for and report evidence on any of the following possible realities: (a) mini/micro bags are genuinely regaining visibility in recent runway shows, retail, or styling coverage; (b) large and oversized bags remain equally or more prominent at the same time (a polarization between very small and very large, rather than a single trend); (c) any renewed attention is concentrated in specific brands or runway moments rather than being a broad, general shift; (d) any attention is driven mainly by a small number of celebrity styling moments rather than a broader industry or retail pattern. Prioritize credible fashion publications and trade/retail sources (Vogue, ELLE, Harper's Bazaar, Marie Claire, other major fashion publications, Fashion Week runway coverage, and credible retail or trend-forecasting sources) over generic entertainment/gossip sites. Specific brand or celebrity examples may be cited as illustrations, but do not center the coverage on celebrity gossip. Also look for any credible reporting connecting small-bag attention to practical factors such as accessory-first styling (bag as accessory rather than functional carry-all), minimalism/decluttering behavior, or any other credible driver — but only report a causal or explanatory link if it is actually stated or supported by a credible source, not as an assumption. Avoid overgeneralizations such as claims that 'everyone' is using tiny bags, do not treat a single celebrity's styling choice as proof of a broad trend, avoid product-catalog-style listing of specific items/prices, avoid unsupported generational claims (e.g. about 'Gen Z') unless directly supported by a cited source, and avoid unsupported economic-anxiety-style causal explanations for the trend. If the evidence for a broad 'tiny bags are back' narrative turns out to be weak, ambiguous, or limited to a narrow runway/celebrity phenomenon, report that limitation directly rather than asserting a general trend.

【役割】
あなたはResearcherです。以下を行いません:
- 記事本文を書く
- Narrativeを作る
- 比喩を考える
- 阪神マスターのstyleを模倣する
あなたが行うのは、Factだけを収集・整理することです。

【Source優先順位】
1. 政府・規制当局等の一次資料
2. 公式調査・報告書
3. 信頼できる二次資料
一次Sourceで確認できるFactを、二次Sourceだけで確定しないでください。

【特に注意して構造化すべき観点(今回のテーマに当てはまる場合のみ)】

1. 対象範囲: 年齢・人数・期間・地域等、Factが適用される範囲(scope)を数値の母集団と混同せずに特定する
2. 制度・仕様の適用条件: default設定なのか常時適用なのか、変更・例外が認められるか等、時間的・条件的scopeを明確にする。一次資料内で表現が揺れている場合は、より明確な一次Sourceを追加で検索する。それでも確定できない場合は、断定せずambiguityフィールドへその旨を明記する
3. 数値の内訳: ある数字が全体を指すのか、特定のサブグループ・条件を指すのかを明確にする。一次資料で直接確認できる場合のみnumeric_valueとして確定し、確認できない場合は推測で数字を作らず、numeric_valueをnullにしてambiguityへその旨を記録する
4. 観察・相関・因果の区別: 変化・効果・傾向等について、観察・報告なのか、相関なのか、Source自身が因果関係を主張しているのかを、causal_strengthで区別する。Sourceより強い因果表現(caused/produced/proved等)を後工程のwriterが使わないよう、causal_strengthとnotes_for_writerで明示する

【出力形式】
各Factについて、fact_id・claim・subject・date_or_period・scope・conditions・numeric_value・
numeric_scope・causal_strength・source_title・source_url・source_type・support_level・
ambiguity・notes_for_writerを埋めてください(該当しない項目はnullで構いません)。
数字・期間・対象範囲があるFactについては、該当項目を必ず明示してください。

facts.notes_for_writer: Supports simultaneous visibility of accessory-like small bags and highly functional larger bags.

facts.claim: ELLE presented mini bags as a major Fall 2026 styling direction and cited palm-sized evening clutches at Khaite and novelty minaudières at Matthieu Blazy's Fall/Winter 2026 Chanel couture show. ([elle.com](https://www.elle.com/fashion/a73435817/mini-bag-trend-fall-2026/?utm_source=openai))
facts.subject: Mini-bag visibility in Fall 2026 fashion coverage
facts.scope: ELLE editorial coverage plus selected Chanel couture and Khaite runway examples
facts.conditions: Fashion/shopping feature; not a consumer adoption survey or sales analysis
facts.source_title: Mini Bags Are the Must-Have Fall Trend—Forget the Tote
facts.ambiguity: The article's headline and examples indicate editorial emphasis but do not demonstrate broad retail dominance.
facts.notes_for_writer: Use as evidence of renewed visibility in styling coverage and selected runway moments, not as proof that mini bags are dominant across the market.

facts.claim: ELLE linked the appeal of very small bags to carrying only a limited set of essentials—such as a phone, wallet, keys, and lip product—and described the bag's value as adding occasion and visual impact rather than storage capacity. ([elle.com](https://www.elle.com/fashion/a73435817/mini-bag-trend-fall-2026/?utm_source=openai))
facts.subject: Minimal-carry and accessory-first explanation
facts.scope: ELLE's editorial interpretation of Fall 2026 mini-bag appeal
facts.conditions: Source-level explanation; no independent consumer-behavior evidence is provided
facts.source_title: Mini Bags Are the Must-Have Fall Trend—Forget the Tote
facts.ambiguity: The article does not establish that minimalism or decluttering caused actual consumer demand.
facts.notes_for_writer: Attribute the explanation to ELLE; do not generalize it into a proven mass-market behavioral driver.

facts.claim: A January 2026 Vogue feature on Bulgari's Icons minaudières described the miniature scale as intentional, with utility being deliberately subordinated to meaning; the designs were presented as carrying a miniature book rather than accommodating a phone. ([vogue.com](https://www.vogue.com/article/small-bags-with-big-ambitions))
facts.subject: Small bag as symbolic accessory
facts.scope: One Bulgari Icons minaudière project and its creative rationale
facts.source_title: Small Bags With Big Ambitions—Introducing Bulgari’s New Icons Minaudières
facts.ambiguity: This is evidence of one brand's stated design philosophy, not proof of a general consumer shift toward minimal carrying.
facts.notes_for_writer: Useful for accessory-first framing; keep the scope confined to Bulgari's project and its stated creative intent.

facts.claim: Marie Claire's Fall 2026 trend report contrasted tiny summer purses with autumn's return to more substantial bags, while still noting smaller clutches, top-handle bags, and intentional hand-held styling. ([marieclaire.com](https://www.marieclaire.com/fashion/fall-2026-handbag-trends/))
facts.subject: Seasonal shift from tiny summer bags toward more substantial Fall 2026 forms
facts.conditions: Editorial trend interpretation; includes both practical totes and smaller fashion-led forms
facts.source_title: Put Away Your Tiny Summer Purse—These 5 Handbag Trends Will Define Fall 2026
facts.ambiguity: The article does not define a measurable threshold for 'tiny' or 'substantial.'
facts.notes_for_writer: Counterbalances ELLE's September mini-bag emphasis and supports a seasonal, mixed-size reading.

facts.claim: Harper's Bazaar's Fall/Winter 2026 roundup, informed by Shopbop and Mytheresa retail executives, emphasized top-handle bags, croc-embossed totes, flap bags, and embellished shoulder bags; Mytheresa described wearing evening bags during the day as an early-2000s-inspired direction. ([harpersbazaar.com](https://www.harpersbazaar.com/fashion/trends/a73445481/fall-winter-bag-trends-2026/))
facts.subject: Retail-informed Fall/Winter 2026 handbag direction
facts.scope: Selected fashion collections plus Shopbop and Mytheresa commentary
facts.conditions: Retail-expert quotes and editorial trend selection; no category-level sales data
facts.ambiguity: The retail comments concern customer preferences generally and do not isolate mini or micro bags.
facts.notes_for_writer: Supports a broader accessory and throwback-bag interest, but not a specific claim that micro bags are driving the category.

facts.claim: ELLE reported that Moda Operandi's handbag business had increased 44% over the previous year, according to the retailer's vice president of non-apparel, who connected current demand with expressive accessories, color, and distinctive points of interest. ([elle.com](https://www.elle.com/fashion/trend-reports/a71462900/little-luxury-accessory-trend-2026/))
facts.subject: Retail demand for expressive accessories
facts.conditions: Retailer statement quoted by ELLE; category definition and sales base are not specified
facts.numeric_scope: Reported increase in Moda Operandi's handbag business over the prior year
facts.source_title: Why Fashion Is Having an Expressive Accessories Moment
facts.ambiguity: The article does not specify whether the 44% figure refers to revenue, units, orders, or another business metric, nor does it isolate mini bags.
facts.notes_for_writer: Use as evidence of stronger accessory engagement at one luxury retailer, not as proof of a general mini-bag sales surge.

facts.claim: The same ELLE report said petite bowling bags were among the first Chanel accessories to sell out after Matthieu Blazy's debut collection reached boutiques. ([elle.com](https://www.elle.com/fashion/trend-reports/a71462900/little-luxury-accessory-trend-2026/?utm_source=openai))
facts.subject: Brand-specific retail response to petite bags
facts.date_or_period: March-June 2026; Chanel retail rollout after Blazy's debut
facts.scope: Chanel accessories associated with one designer debut
facts.conditions: Report of a specific brand and collection moment
facts.source_title: Why Fashion Is Having an Expressive Accessories Moment
facts.ambiguity: No sell-through rate, unit count, or comparison with larger Chanel bags is provided.
facts.notes_for_writer: Supports the possibility that renewed small-bag attention is concentrated in specific brands or high-profile designer debuts.

facts.claim: Trendalytics reported that oversized bags had reclaimed runway and retail visibility in 2026 and stated that oversized clutches showed a 152% increase in retail-market adoption. ([trendalytics.co](https://trendalytics.co/insights/handbag-market-trends-2026-report))
facts.subject: Oversized-bag retail and runway momentum
facts.scope: Trendalytics proprietary trend and retail analysis
facts.conditions: Commercial trend-forecasting report; full dataset and methodology are gated
facts.numeric_scope: Trendalytics-reported increase in retail-market adoption of oversized clutches
facts.source_title: Handbag Trends 2026: Market Data & Rising Designer Favorites
facts.ambiguity: The public page does not define the sample, baseline period, geographic coverage, or exact meaning of 'retail-market adoption.'
facts.notes_for_writer: Important counterweight to a tiny-bag-only narrative; qualify the figure as Trendalytics' proprietary estimate.

facts.claim: LIVETREND's retail-radar report on Fall/Winter 2024 bag evolution reported year-on-year growth of 93% for maxi bags and 68% for bucket bags, while mini bags were reported at minus 11%. It interpreted the larger-bag growth as aligned with demand for space and practicality. ([livetrend.co](https://livetrend.co/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/BAGS-RETAIL-RADAR_nu20250915.pdf))
facts.subject: Retail evolution by handbag size/category
facts.conditions: Trend-forecasting report; the cited page describes the analysis as FW24 bag evolution
facts.numeric_scope: Year-on-year change reported for the listed bag categories
facts.ambiguity: The excerpt does not fully specify the retailer sample, geography, or exact comparison period; the report is older than the 2026 coverage.
facts.notes_for_writer: Use as historical retail counterevidence, not as a direct measurement of the September 2026 market.

facts.claim: Who What Wear reported that Fashionphile's resale-trend analysis found searches for 'micro bag' had doubled year over year and searches for top-handle bags had risen 68.2% year over year. ([whowhatwear.com](https://www.whowhatwear.com/fashion/shopping/fashionphile-resale-report-bag-trends))
facts.subject: Resale/search attention for micro and top-handle bags
facts.scope: Fashionphile search behavior within its resale ecosystem
facts.conditions: Reported by Who What Wear from a Fashionphile report; search activity, not confirmed purchases
facts.numeric_scope: Year-over-year change in reported Fashionphile search activity
facts.source_title: The Bag Trends That Will Be Popular in 2025, according to Fashionphile.
facts.ambiguity: The original Fashionphile report was not directly accessible in the retrieved source, and search growth does not establish sales or broad consumer adoption.
facts.notes_for_writer: Evidence of renewed interest within a resale/search platform; keep the platform-specific scope explicit.

facts.claim: Vogue's Spring 2026 celebrity-bag coverage stated that a single paparazzi image can make a bag an 'It bag' and listed a revived Bottega Veneta style that also came in a mini size and Valentino's daintier DeVain bag carried by celebrities. ([vogue.com](https://www.vogue.com/article/celebrity-it-bags-spring-2026-trends))
facts.subject: Celebrity amplification of handbag visibility
facts.scope: Celebrity styling and selected designer bags
facts.conditions: Editorial celebrity-style analysis; no population-level adoption evidence
facts.source_title: These Are Fast Becoming the 8 Celebrity It Bags of the Season
facts.ambiguity: The source's causal framing is editorial and does not quantify the effect of celebrity exposure on sales.
facts.notes_for_writer: Supports the possibility that some small-bag attention is celebrity-amplified; do not treat celebrity sightings as proof of a broad industry trend.

facts.claim: Vogue documented a small group of celebrities—Rihanna, Gigi Hadid, and Sofia Richie Grainge—carrying tiny purses during several weeks in late 2024 and described the styling as an alternative to oversized purses. ([vogue.com](https://www.vogue.com/article/gigi-hadid-rihanna-sofia-richie-grainge-tiny-purse))
facts.subject: Celebrity examples of tiny-purse styling
facts.numeric_scope: Named celebrity examples in the article
facts.source_title: Gigi Hadid, Rihanna, and Sofia Richie Grainge Agree: Everyone Loves a Tiny Purse!
facts.ambiguity: The article does not establish how common the behavior was outside the named examples.
facts.notes_for_writer: Use only as illustration of celebrity styling, not as evidence that 'everyone' or the general public adopted tiny bags.

facts.claim: Marie Claire reported that Coach's Fall 2026 runway included both oversize leather messenger bags and mini east-west bags with coin-purse closures. ([marieclaire.com](https://www.marieclaire.com/fashion/fall-fashion/coach-fall-2026-fashion-show/?utm_source=openai))
facts.subject: Coexistence of large and mini bags within one brand collection
facts.source_title: Welcome to Coach's Black Parade—Its Fall 2026 Fashion Show, That Is
facts.ambiguity: The article's suggestion that the bags might appeal to particular style groups is interpretive and not supported by consumer data.
facts.notes_for_writer: Useful brand-level example of size polarization; keep the conclusion limited to Coach's collection.
